domain_hint: Centrifugal pump CFD head–capacity prediction using steady RANS (SST) with rotating machinery modeling
ambiguity_notes:
- Mesh/solution independence: two different grid triplets reported with conflicting GCI (0.6% vs 2.6%) and spreads up to 7.5% elsewhere
- Time-dependence: steady MRF results used despite transient sliding-mesh showing 8–12% periodic head variation
- Near-wall modeling: claimed low-Re SST target (y+<1) but actual y+ 35–80 on blades and 120–250 in volute; solver switched to wall functions inconsistently
- Boundary conditions and test match: switched between pressure outlet and mass-flow outlet; validation mixed between affinity-scaled 3600 rpm and direct 3000 rpm data
- Validation accuracy: slide claims +3% at BEP vs scaled curve but elsewhere notes 8–10% discrepancies at matched 3000 rpm points
- Scope creep on cavitation: cavitation “deferred,” yet NPSHr guidance plotted as advisory, potentially misleading
- Software QA: different STAR-CCM+ versions used across grids; turbulence model defaults may differ, undermining reproducibility
